belady.description: The canonical Belady's Anomaly reference string. FIFO: 9 faults @3 frames, 10 faults @4 frames.

locality.description: A working-set-style reference string with strong temporal locality (small hot set revisited often, occasional far jumps) -- LRU should noticeably beat FIFO here.

sequential_worst_case.description: Pure sequential scan longer than the frame count -- the pathological worst case for LRU (every reference is a fault, LRU degrades to FIFO-like behavior since nothing is ever revisited before eviction).
